mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_item (symbol, market, stock_name, image_url, enabled, source, group_key, analysis_mode, analysis_interval_minutes, anomaly_trigger_mode, weekly_review_enabled, monthly_review_enabled, analysis_policy_version, analysis_policy_modified_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{imageUrl}, #{enabled}, #{source}, #{groupKey}, #{analysisMode}, #{analysisIntervalMinutes}, #{anomalyTriggerMode}, #{weeklyReviewEnabled}, #{monthlyReviewEnabled}, #{analysisPolicyVersion}, #{analysisPolicyModifiedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_item SET stock_name = #{stockName}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, enabled = #{enabled}, source = #{source}, group_key = #{groupKey}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE stock_watch_item SET analysis_mode = #{record.analysisMode}, analysis_interval_minutes = #{record.analysisIntervalMinutes}, anomaly_trigger_mode = #{record.anomalyTriggerMode}, weekly_review_enabled = #{record.weeklyReviewEnabled}, monthly_review_enabled = #{record.monthlyReviewEnabled}, analysis_policy_version = analysis_policy_version + 1, analysis_policy_modified_at = NOW(), gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{record.id} AND analysis_policy_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_item WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY CASE group_key WHEN 'holding' THEN 1 WHEN 'watch' THEN 2 WHEN 'candidate' THEN 3 WHEN 'archived' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, gmt_create ASC, id ASC
